ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with a predominant light-intensity (white/light grey) base occupying approximately 60% of the visible surface, punctuated by low-intensity (dark/black) mottled regions occupying approximately 40%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dense, dark-intensity irregular mottling concentrated along the distal trailing edges and the outer tips of both lobes. A large, low-intensity contiguous region is centered at the junction of the two lobes, extending vertically from the peduncle insertion.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 58 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 2-8 pixels; most prominent on the outer thirds of the trailing edge, featuring several distinct peaks and troughs.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges follow a consistent concave curve from the median notch to the distal tips, while the visible portions of the leading edge exhibit a convex sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-density clusters of small, circular, low-intensity pixel groups (approximately 5-15 pixels in diameter) concentrated on the right lobe tip and along the upper trailing edge margins.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular jaggedness and localized indentations along the trailing edge of the right lobe distal tip, suggesting minor historical tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-density 'salt-and-pepper' mottling pattern localized specifically at the terminal points of both fluke lobes.
